expectation: Cytoplasmic, fibrous signal in smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes. Expect rings around vessels and elongated stromal bands between tumour nests, leaving epithelial and immune cell areas mostly negative. Common in the stroma.
observed: A: ring-shaped vessel walls in several cores and long fibrous stromal bands that weave around nuclei-dense nests. B and C: elongated fibrous bundles kept apart from the nuclei-rich areas. D: a ring-like fibrous band of cells, the shape of a vessel wall.
why: Rings around vessels and fibrous stromal networks that do not overlap the dense nuclear regions are the structure expected of SMA, not haze or grain.
notes: SMA marks vessel-wall rings and fibrous stromal bands across many cores and stays out of the cell-dense nests. One core (row 3, column 2) is dim and hazy, but the overall pattern is clearly specific.
